mechanism: Methylprednisolone induces CYP3A4 metabolism of eplerenone, reducing its plasma concentrations and efficacy, while both drugs increase potassium retention risk through mineralocorticoid antagonism and glucocorticoid effects on electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels closely and consider increasing eplerenone dose or selecting an alternative corticosteroid with less enzyme induction; assess blood pressure and renal function regularly.
